title: berman.connection/1
description: A named project description (connection.json), read by the controller when it commissions and when a co-located workspace is read. Loading needs only schema and id: documents and checks are read when an assignment is made from them. What is typed here is every list Berman iterates, because text in its place would be read character by character without complaint. Check identities, timeouts and expected output are converted and judged by berman.checks; the identity by berman.config. Fields Berman only stores or prints are not constrained.

argv.description: Arguments; each is converted to text.
